Subject: Follow-up & quick compliance questions after demo

Hi Sam — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Helpful conversation; two quick follow-ups so my team can finish the qualification checklist:

1) SOC 2 status: do you need our Type II report or just the attestation?
2) Data retention: you asked about logs (request logs, KV/cache, backups). Can you confirm the retention window you require for logs vs. backups?
3) GDPR/HIPAA: any specific data locality or DPIA requirements beyond what we discussed?

I can loop in Ben (security lead) and Marissa (Customer Success) to provide artifacts. Proposed next step: if HealthSync can share a vendor questionnaire (or we’ll send ours), we’ll return completed answers + evidence within 3 business days.

Next step: I’ll attach our standard retention matrix and SOC2 bucket to the thread for Legal Ops to review. Is anyone else on your side who should be looped in?

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@healthsync.com>
To: priyom_das
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & quick compliance questions after demo

Thanks, Priyom — great demo. Quick answers:

- For SOC 2 we need the Type II report (latest 12 months) and any bridge letter if there are coverage gaps.
- Retention windows we care about:
  • Auth/request logs: 12 months
  • Application events (forensics): 3 years
  • Backups/snapshots: 1 year (with the ability to request extended retention up to 3 years for legal holds)
- HIPAA: we need a signed BAA and confirmation that ePHI is stored and processed only in our US region.

I can send our vendor questionnaire (legalops@healthsync.com) — please fill and return. Timelines: Legal wants evidence within 5 business days after questionnaire return.

Sam
Director of IT Security | HealthSync
sam.patel@healthsync.com

Looping you both. HealthSync needs: SOC 2 Type II report, retention table matching their windows (auth logs 12m, app events 3y, backups 1y with legal-hold option), BAA signed and confirmation of US-only processing for ePHI. They said Legal Ops will send a questionnaire (VQ-8675).

Can you do the following?
- Ben: confirm which artifacts we can share immediately (SOC2 PDF, controls map, retention matrix). Also confirm whether we support legal-hold extended retention for backups and how that workflow looks (TTL override / manual snapshot retention).
- Marissa: draft the BAA (we have a template) and confirm timeline for signature + who owns making ePHI processing region-limited in Private/Dedicated deployments.

Attachments I’m adding: SOC2_TypeII_certificate.pdf, data_retention_matrix.xlsx. I’ll add the vendor questionnaire when it arrives.

Thanks — Priyom
From: ben_carter
To: priyom_das, marissa_cole
Date: 2026-02-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up & quick compliance questions after demo

Quick update from Security:

- We can share the SOC 2 Type II PDF and a controls mapping (not attached here for OPSEC, will share via Drive link once PR is approved).
- Retention: our standard matrix (attached) already captures auth logs=12 months and app events=3 years. Backups default to 1 year TTL. For legal-hold we support a manual retention extension process: Customer Support opens a Support case with the retention request, Security approves, and the infra team marks snapshot as preserved (no-prune tag). We’ll need HealthSync to acknowledge the administrative SLA: 3 business days to enact a legal hold once requested.
- ePHI & regionality: For Dedicated and Private deployments we can guarantee US-only processing when configured; for Hosted accounts we offer region controls but need a contract addendum (we have a regionality attestation flow).

Next steps I’ll do:
- Upload evidence bundle to the shared Drive and produce a short control-summary doc for Legal Ops.
- Fill VSA_vendor_questionnaire.docx once received and return within 2 business days.

Ben Carter
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference

Thanks for the clarity — that workflow sounds fine. A few closing items from Legal Ops after initial review:

- Please upload the SOC2 Type II PDF and the controls summary to the Drive link you mentioned. We’ll only accept files via that shared folder (internal policy).
- We’ll send VQ-8675 (vendor questionnaire) by EOD tomorrow; please return within 48 hours if possible.
- BAA: Legal Ops will send a redline request if your standard BAA has region/processing exceptions — we’ll review and flag anything that looks like a non-US processing clause.

If you can commit to evidence upload + completed questionnaire within the next 48–72 hours, we’ll move forward to legal review and procurement.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Sam
